teaching.en: I am asking about suitcase B17. The report was received on 5 March, and the ownership details were checked on 6 March. The suitcase was located on 7 March. It is now being held at the airport service desk. Delivery has not been arranged, so that is the pending stage. The record moves from reception to identity review, location, holding and delivery. Please confirm the exact date and time when delivery will be arranged and tell me when that booking will be sent.

answer.text: I am checking the status of laptop L24. The request was received on 8 April, the diagnosis was completed on 9 April, and the keyboard was replaced on 10 April. The final test is being carried out now, so that is the current stage. Collection has not been scheduled and remains the only pending step. The order is reception, diagnosis, replacement, testing and collection. Please confirm the date and time when collection will be arranged, so I know when I can receive the repaired laptop.
accepted: I am checking the status of laptop L24. The request was received on 8 April, the diagnosis was completed on 9 April, and the keyboard was replaced on 10 April. The final test is being carried out now, so that is the current stage. Collection has not been scheduled and remains the only pending step. The order is reception, diagnosis, replacement, testing and collection. Please confirm the date and time when collection will be arranged, so I know when I can receive the repaired laptop.

Could you update me on laptop L24? Its request was received on 8 April. Diagnosis was finished on 9 April, and the keyboard was replaced on 10 April. A final test is being completed at present. After that, collection is still pending because no appointment is scheduled. The record therefore moves from reception to diagnosis, replacement, testing and collection. Please tell me exactly when collection will be booked and provide its date and time, so I can plan to receive the laptop.

feedback.es: Las respuestas integran pasivas, orden, pendiente y petición sobre recogida.

origin.text: Portátil L24: recibido 8 April; diagnóstico 9 April; teclado reemplazado 10 April; prueba final en curso; recogida no programada. Pide fecha y hora de recogida.
